study_title: Forecast Maturity of Technical Performance Margin on NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Data
design: Secondary fixed-checkpoint prognostics analysis of laboratory battery aging time series
canonical_source: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence Battery Data Set
eol_definition: 30% fade in rated capacity, from 2.0 Ah to 1.4 Ah
rebuild_policy: Official NASA archive only; nested ZIPs are recursively expanded and MATLAB files are parsed directly. No synthetic fallback.
scientific_correction: The prototype's first-60%-of-final-history split was horizon-dependent. Version 1.1 uses fixed checkpoints 40, 60, and 80 for every cell.
claim_boundary: Transparent descriptive baseline on four NASA laboratory cells. Forecast revision is not calibrated uncertainty and results are not evidence of production readiness or cross-cell generalization.
